Gesture Description: Touch the tip of your non-dominant thumb with your dominant index finger. (Or single-handed: closed fist with thumb upright along the side).
Both hands form circles with thumb and index touching, joined together like binoculars (or 4 straight fingers upright with thumb folded).
Hand curved into a clear, open "C" shape facing inward.

Teaching Tip: Form a D against vertical index
Gesture Description: Non-dominant index pointing vertically up; dominant thumb and index form a curved semicircle touching its tip and base to form a "D".
Touch the tip of your non-dominant index finger with your dominant index finger.
Dominant index and middle fingers placed horizontally across non-dominant index and middle fingers.
Dominant fist placed on top of or against non-dominant fist (or index and thumb pointing horizontally).
Dominant flat open palm placed flat across non-dominant open palm.
Touch the tip of your non-dominant middle finger with your dominant index finger. (Or single-handed: pinky extended straight up from fist).

Teaching Tip: Trace down palm from middle finger
Gesture Description: Dominant index touches non-dominant middle fingertip and draws a "J" curve down the palm to the wrist.
Dominant index finger hooked/bent touching the first knuckle/joint of non-dominant extended index finger.

Teaching Tip: Vertical index on flat palm / L-shape
Gesture Description: Dominant extended index finger resting vertically on non-dominant flat palm (forming an "L"). Or thumb and index at 90° angle.
Dominant 3 fingers (index, middle, ring) resting downward onto non-dominant flat palm.
Dominant 2 fingers (index, middle) resting downward onto non-dominant flat palm.
Touch the tip of your non-dominant ring finger with your dominant index finger. (Or single-handed: all fingertips touching thumb tip forming an O).
Dominant thumb and index form a circle loop touching the tip of non-dominant index finger pointing vertically up.
Dominant thumb and index form a circle hooked around the base of non-dominant extended thumb.
Dominant hooked/curved index finger resting on the center of non-dominant flat palm.

Teaching Tip: Pinkies linked or fist on palm
Gesture Description: Dominant pinky finger hooked with non-dominant pinky finger, or dominant closed fist resting against non-dominant palm.

Teaching Tip: Index touching side edge of palm
Gesture Description: Dominant extended index finger touching the side edge of non-dominant flat palm near the pinky base.
Touch the tip of your non-dominant pinky finger with your dominant index finger. (Or single-handed: index and middle extended together).
Dominant index and middle fingers spread in a "V" resting on non-dominant open palm (or single-handed peace sign).
Both hands with open palms, fingers interlaced together (or single-handed 3 fingers spread up).
Both index fingers crossed over each other to form an "X".
Dominant index finger placed into the V-crotch between non-dominant extended thumb and index finger (or thumb and pinky extended).
Dominant flat hand resting along the upper edge of non-dominant flat hand.
